architecture: Atomic metadata written before configuration mutation
No passwords, SSIDs, full config or credentials in metadata
Full session marker on owned temporary wireless/network sections
SSH fingerprint must match before recovery
Restore only recorded interface disabled flags; never replace wireless/network files
Configuration and runtime evidence both required before deleting recovery record
Keep pending records across app restart; block new wireless tasks until recovery
Reconnect UI announces recovery and preserves record on cancel/failure

compatibility: Exact source contracts do not establish live compatibility for every firmware and hardware combination.

round_1.scope: Pinned OpenWrt UCI command results, staging and netifd reload semantics; Python atomic file replacement
round_1.finding: Verification did not inherit cancellation and total recovery deadline
round_1.fix: Pass cancellation and remaining deadline through configuration reads, runtime observations and settling; preserve legacy cleanup result contract

round_2.scope: Write-ahead ordering, process restart, failed disk write and malformed recovery metadata
findings: arm replaced in-memory scope before durable save succeeded
modified interfaces could name radios outside the declared affected set
fixes: Save candidate metadata before publishing the in-memory state
Reject inconsistent affected-radio scope before any router command

round_3.scope: Wrong owner, missing marker, user configuration conflicts, failed reads, partial commit, repeat recovery
round_3.finding: Failed disabled-option read could be accepted as an originally absent option
round_3.fix: Require explicit UCI NOTFOUND evidence for an unset option; reject other read failures before mutation
round_3.validation: 75 targeted tests: 74 passed, 1 platform skip; 9 generated POSIX script cases passed against isolated fake UCI state

limits: No live disconnect or router mutation performed

Unmarked historical interfaces are not deleted automatically

Timeout budgets cover recovery requests and verification; transport setup and final output draining may add overhead

round_1.scope: First persistent UCI write, owner identification, activation order and older UCI implementations
round_1.finding: A disconnect between ordinary section creation and its owner option left an unidentifiable section
round_1.fix: Create with a full-session private section type, write the option marker, then activate the standard type. Both owner representations are checked strictly.
round_1.source_contracts: Seven exact UCI revisions from the existing 50-release index retain options across section-type changes; pinned netifd processes only standard active types
round_1.validation: 27 production setup prefixes executed against the pinned official UCI CLI core; each recovered twice successfully

round_2.scope: Interrupted cleanup, commit and repetition using real UCI configuration files
round_2.validation: Completed: 17 injected UCI call failures followed by successful recovery and a second idempotent cleanup; combined with 27 successful setup prefixes, 44 real-UCI file cases passed. Earlier incomplete audit run is not counted as a whole-run pass.
round_2.audit_harness_issue: One 15-second harness timeout after setup-prefix validation. Continuation copies the CLI binary to a Linux-local temporary directory to remove cross-filesystem executable overhead; production timeouts were not relaxed.

round_3.scope: Login gate, canceled recovery, deleted UI progress receiver, legacy records and unrelated section preservation
round_3.finding: An exception from an optional UI progress callback could stop required restoration
round_3.fix: Log a fixed privacy-safe notification failure and continue restoration; explicit cancellation remains authoritative
round_3.validation: 78 focused Windows tests: 77 passed, 1 platform skip. Nine generated POSIX guard cases passed with simulated UCI state.

limits: No live router mutation or deliberate SSH disconnect

ubus reload is stubbed in file-based UCI tests; runtime radio restoration is covered only by offline tests
Windows tests and WSL backend command execution do not establish Debian GUI compatibility
Simultaneous external configuration edits and router power loss remain unverified

second_three_round_review.status: Three rounds completed; two production defects fixed; live router validation remains pending

third_three_round_review.scope: Third independent three-round audit of persistent password-verification cleanup. No live device mutations or UI changes.

round_1.scope: UCI package commit and unrelated staged settings
round_1.finding: Package commits could also persist unrelated preexisting or newly staged network/wireless settings
round_1.fix: Shared pending-change checks reject unrelated settings before initial setup or recovery. Before mutation, compare digests with the checked snapshot; no raw pending values appear in requests, metadata or logs.
round_1.source: Pinned official UCI CLI changes/commit implementation; SHA-256 applet enabled by default in all 50 exact releases in the existing support index

round_2.scope: Persisted metadata read bounds and strict schema validation
round_2.finding: A stat-only size check allowed a subsequently growing file to be read without a hard bound; boolean schema values compared equal to integer version one
round_2.fix: Read at most 131073 bytes and reject excess; require an exact integer schema. Malformed records remain on disk.
round_2.limits: Atomic replacement and file flush cover ordinary application restart; abrupt host power-loss durability is not newly established.

round_3.scope: Direct shell execution, stale snapshots, privacy, cancellation and evidence before acknowledgement
round_3.fix: Validate checksum capability during the read-only phase and compare only the digest field, independent of text/binary output markers.

full_targeted_run.error_kind: Existing Git Bash readback tests exceeded their unchanged 10-second subprocess deadlines; one passed individually, but three timed out in the latest complete run.
